changes: Reconnect the complete current LP, KC, GF, CR, CM, GS, IR, DT and PDO proofs, retaining their component notices.
Make the one common proper diagonal neighborhood explicit as the complement of a locally finite closed forbidden union.
Specify the exact canonical transition preserving tau, reduced symplectic volume, time derivative and ordinary inverse graph symbol class.
Construct the full microlocal identity/zero cutoff for the clopen characteristic split, with every lower order controlled.
Make all reciprocal derivative estimates explicit and update the wider-course status without discarding restored providers.
Preserve every original display, full solution and the exact coordinate figure.
